Button.d: Starts an action. Use one primary button per view, and let severity say how serious the action is.

IconButton.d: A button that shows only an icon. It always has an accessible label, shown as a tooltip on hover.
ex: <button class="btn btn-secondary icon-btn" aria-label="Settings"><svg class="i"><use href="#i-settings"/></svg></button><button class="btn btn-ghost icon-btn" aria-label="More actions"><svg class="i"><use href="#i-more"/></svg></button><button class="btn btn-primary icon-btn" aria-label="Add service"><svg class="i"><use href="#i-plus"/></svg></button><button class="btn btn-solid sev-critical icon-btn" aria-label="Delete"><svg class="i"><use href="#i-trash"/></svg></button>

<IconButton label="Settings" icon={<SettingsIcon />} />
<IconButton label="More actions" variant="ghost" icon={<MoreIcon />} />
<IconButton label="Delete" intent="danger" icon={<TrashIcon />} />
a11y: label becomes aria-label and the tooltip, so sighted and screen-reader users get the same name.
IconButton.do: Use for repeated, well-known actions in toolbars and table rows.
IconButton.dont: Don’t use for the main action on a page. Give it words.

Menu.d: A list of actions that opens from a button. Destructive items sit last, after a divider.
ex:
Open timelineT
Snooze alertsS
Copy ID
Delete service…

<Menu trigger={<IconButton label="Actions" icon={<MoreIcon />} />}>
  <MenuItem icon={<TimelineIcon />} shortcut="T">Open timeline</MenuItem>
  <MenuItem icon={<SnoozeIcon />} shortcut="S">Snooze alerts</MenuItem>
  <MenuSeparator />
  <MenuItem intent="danger">Delete service…</MenuItem>
</Menu>
props: Keyboard hint shown on the right.
a11y: Arrow keys move, Enter selects, Esc closes and returns focus to the trigger.
menu and menuitem roles; disabled items stay focusable with aria-disabled.
Menu.do: End destructive items with an ellipsis when they open a confirmation.
Menu.dont: Don’t hide the only way to do a common task inside a menu.

Input.d: Single-line text entry. Wrap it in Field for a label, hint and error.
props: Icon inside the start of the field.
Error styling. Field sets this for you.
a11y: Always pair with a visible label. Placeholders disappear and are not labels.
Field links the error with aria-describedby and sets aria-invalid.
Input.do: Show the expected format in the hint before someone gets it wrong.
Input.dont: Don’t validate on every keystroke. Validate on blur or submit.

NumberInput.d: Numeric entry with steppers, units and tabular figures. For values with safe ranges, use LimitedNumberInput.
props: Hard bounds. Values outside are rejected.
a11y: Up and Down step; Page Up and Page Down step by 10.
spinbutton with aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax and aria-valuenow.
NumberInput.do: Always show the unit next to the number.
NumberInput.dont: Don’t use for IDs, phone numbers or codes. Those are text.

Textarea.d: Multi-line text, such as notes, reasons and descriptions. Grows with content up to a maximum height.
ex: Shown on the service timeline.

<Field label="Reason for change" hint="Shown on the service timeline." required>
  <Textarea autoGrow maxRows={8} />
</Field>
props: Shows a counter near the limit.
a11y: The character counter is announced politely when within 20 characters of the limit.
Textarea.do: Ask for a reason when a change needs one later.

Search.d: A search field with clear, loading and keyboard shortcut, plus live suggestions grouped by type. For site-wide commands, see CommandPalette.
ex:
<Search placeholder="Search services, people, incidents"
  shortcut="/"
  suggestions={(q) => searchIndex(q)}
  groupBy="type"
  recent={recentSearches}
  onSelect={(item) => navigate(item.href)} />

/
/

<Search size="sm" />
<Search shortcut="/" />
<Search size="lg" shape="pill" placeholder="Search the docs" />
/

<Search defaultValue="payments" />
<Search loading defaultValue="checkout" />
<Search disabled placeholder="Search is unavailable while offline" />
props: Say what can be searched: “Search services”.
Shown when the field is empty and focused.
Focuses the field from anywhere, such as “/”.
a11y: The wrapper is role="search"; with suggestions the input is a combobox with aria-expanded and aria-activedescendant.
Up and Down move through suggestions, Enter selects, Esc clears then closes. The shortcut focuses the field.
The number of results is announced politely as it changes.
Search.do: Show recent searches on focus and highlight the matching text.
Search.dont: Don’t search on every keystroke without a debounce, and don’t hide the clear button.

Select.d: Choose one option from a short list. For long lists, use a searchable combobox.
ex: Locked while a deploy runs.
a11y: Renders a native select for reliable keyboard and screen-reader support.
Select.do: Order options by frequency or alphabetically.
Select.dont: Don’t use for two options. Use Radio or Switch.

Checkbox.d: Independent yes-or-no choices, and multi-select lists. Supports an indeterminate state for “some selected”.
ex: <fieldset style="border:0;padding:0;margin:0" class="stack"><legend style="font-weight:550;font-size:var(--text-sm);margin-bottom:8px">Notify me about</legend><label class="check"><input type="checkbox" checked>Critical alerts</label><label class="check"><input type="checkbox" checked>Caution alerts</label><label class="check"><input type="checkbox">Advisory alerts</label></fieldset>

<CheckboxGroup label="Notify me about" defaultValue={['critical','caution']}>
  <Checkbox value="critical">Critical alerts</Checkbox>
  <Checkbox value="caution">Caution alerts</Checkbox>
  <Checkbox value="advisory">Advisory alerts</Checkbox>
</CheckboxGroup>
a11y: Wrap related checkboxes in a fieldset with a legend.
Checkbox.do: Phrase labels positively: “Send alerts”, not “Don’t send alerts”.
Checkbox.dont: Don’t use a checkbox to trigger an immediate action. Use Switch.

Radio.d: Pick exactly one from two to five visible options.
ex:
<RadioGroup label="Deploy strategy" defaultValue="rolling">
  <Radio value="rolling">Rolling</Radio>
  <Radio value="blue-green">Blue-green</Radio>
  <Radio value="canary" disabled>Canary (needs 3 pods)</Radio>
</RadioGroup>
a11y: Arrow keys move selection within the group; Tab leaves the group.
Radio.dont: Don’t use for more than five options.

Switch.d: Turns a setting on or off immediately, with no save step.
ex:
<Switch defaultChecked>Group repeat alerts</Switch>
<Switch>Page me on advisory</Switch>
Switch.do: Use for settings that take effect at once.
Switch.dont: Don’t use inside a form that needs a Save button.

Field.d: Wraps any input with a label, hint, warning or error, and wires up the accessibility attributes.
ex: Enter a full email address, like oncall@company.com.

<Field label="Alert email" required error="Enter a full email address, like oncall@company.com.">
  <Input type="email" />
</Field>
a11y: Connects label, hint and error with htmlFor and aria-describedby automatically.
Field.do: Write errors that say how to fix the problem.

Badge.d: A short status label. Every severity badge carries an icon or text, never colour alone.
ex: NormalInfoAdvisoryCautionCritical
a11y: The icon shape changes per level: circle, circle, diamond, triangle, octagon.
Badge.do: Keep labels to one or two words.
Badge.dont: Don’t use solid badges for normal status. Save emphasis for problems.

Banner.d: A message across a page or section that stays until resolved or dismissed.
ex:
Disk above 85% on 3 hosts

Free space before 90%, when writes slow down.

<Banner severity="caution" title="Disk above 85% on 3 hosts"
  action={<Button size="sm">View hosts</Button>}>
  Free space before 90%, when writes slow down.
</Banner>
a11y: Critical banners use role="alert"; others use role="status".
Banner.do: Group repeated causes into one banner with a count.
Banner.dont: Don’t stack more than two banners. Summarise instead.

Toast.d: A brief confirmation in the corner that leaves on its own. Critical toasts stay until dismissed.
props: Uses the action’s verb: Publish becomes Published.
0 keeps it open. Critical defaults to 0.
Merges repeats into one toast with a count.
a11y: Polite live region; critical and caution use assertive.
Hover and focus pause the timer. Nothing important lives only in a toast.
Toast.do: Offer Undo instead of a confirmation for reversible actions.
Toast.dont: Don’t use toasts for errors that need a decision. Use a Dialog.

Spinner.d: Shows a short wait of under a few seconds. For longer work, show progress.
a11y: role="status" with a visually hidden label.
Spinner.do: Delay showing it by 300ms to avoid flicker.
Spinner.dont: Don’t block a whole page with a spinner. Use Skeleton.

Skeleton.d: A placeholder in the shape of content that is loading, so layout doesn’t jump.

ProgressBar.d: Shows known progress, or a level against capacity with severity.
ex: Disk87%
a11y: progressbar with aria-valuenow; severity is also given in text.
ProgressBar.do: Show the number next to the bar.
ProgressBar.dont: Don’t rely on bar colour to signal a problem.

EmptyState.d: Fills an empty area with what happened and what to do next.
ex:
No alerts in the last 24 hours

Everything on this service is in range.

<EmptyState title="No alerts in the last 24 hours">
  Everything on this service is in range.
</EmptyState>
a11y: Title is a heading at the right level for its container.
EmptyState.do: Offer the action that fills it.

Dialog.d: Blocks the page for a decision. Dialogs, sheets, popovers, menus and tooltips share this page.
props: Esc and backdrop close. False for destructive flows mid-action.
a11y: Focus moves into the dialog, is trapped, and returns to the trigger on close.
Dialog.do: Name the confirm button with the action: “Delete service”.

Drawer.d: A side sheet for detail and editing without losing your place.
ex: <button class="btn btn-secondary" data-open-dlg="dlg-sheet"><svg class="i"><use href="#i-timeline"/></svg>Open detail sheet</button>
a11y: Behaves like Dialog: focus trap and Esc to close.
Drawer.do: Keep the primary action in the footer.

Popover.d: Rich content anchored to a trigger, such as explanations and small forms.
ex: Why 62?Latency is the largest factor (−21).
Popover.do: Use to explain a number in place.
Popover.dont: Don’t put required steps in a popover.

Tooltip.d: A short label on hover or focus. Never holds essential information.
ex: Locked until all checks pass

<Tooltip content="Locked until all checks pass">
  <Button disabled>Publish</Button>
</Tooltip>
a11y: Shows on keyboard focus; disabled triggers use aria-disabled so they stay focusable.
Tooltip.dont: Don’t put links or actions inside.

Tabs.d: Switch between views of the same thing. Segmented style for filters and time ranges.
a11y: Arrow keys move between tabs; Home and End jump.
Tabs.do: Keep tab labels to one or two words.
Tabs.dont: Don’t use tabs for steps in a sequence.

Breadcrumbs.d: Shows where the current page sits in a hierarchy.
ex: Productioneu-westpayments-api
props: Last item is the current page.
Breadcrumbs.do: Include the environment as the first crumb.
Breadcrumbs.dont: Don’t repeat the page title elsewhere in the crumb.

Pagination.d: Moves through pages of a table or list, with a range summary.
ex: …1–25 of 289
a11y: Prev and next have aria-labels; the current page has aria-current.

SideNav.d: The main app navigation, with groups, icons and alert counts.
ex:
Monitor
Station1ServicesTimeline
a11y: nav with aria-label; active item has aria-current.
SideNav.do: Show only counts that need action.
SideNav.dont: Don’t show counts for normal items.

CommandPalette.d: Search and run commands from anywhere with Ctrl K. Try it on this site.
a11y: Input is a combobox with aria-activedescendant; results are a listbox.
CommandPalette.do: Show recent items when the query is empty.
CommandPalette.dont: Don’t hide destructive commands here without a confirm step.

Card.d: Groups related content with an optional header and footer.
ex:
On call

Covered
R. Iyer until 18:00, then A. Kaur.

<Card title="On call" action={<Badge severity="normal">Covered</Badge>}>
  R. Iyer until 18:00, then A. Kaur.
</Card>
a11y: title renders a heading; set level with as.

Table.d: Rows of records with sorting, selection, bulk actions and row menus.
a11y: Sortable headers are buttons with aria-sort.
Numeric columns align right in tabular figures.
Table.do: Sort by severity, worst first, by default.

Chart.d: Line, area and bar charts with threshold bands, hover readouts and legends. Used across the example dashboards.
ex:
<Chart type="line" data={latency} x="time"
  series={[{ key: 'p95', label: 'p95 latency' }]}
  threshold={{ value: 400, label: 'limit 400 ms', severity: 'caution' }} />
a11y: Every chart has a hidden data table and an aria-label summary.
Chart.do: Show the threshold the line is judged against.

Avatar.d: A person or team, with initials or an image and optional presence.
props: Used for initials and alt text.
a11y: Image alt or aria-label from name.
Avatar.do: Show owners next to the entity they own.
Avatar.dont: Don’t rely on avatars alone; show the name nearby.

Kbd.do: Show the platform key: Ctrl on Windows, ⌘ on Mac.

Code.d: Inline code and copyable code blocks.
Code.do: Keep lines short enough to read without scrolling.

Sparkline.d: A word-sized trend line, with an optional threshold.

HealthScore.d: One number from many signals, with the factors that moved it.
ex: <HealthScore value={62} factors={factors} bands={{ advisory: 85, caution: 70, critical: 50 }} />
a11y: Score, band and top factor are given as text, not just the ring.
HealthScore.do: Show the biggest factor next to the score.
HealthScore.dont: Don’t show a score without its factors.

VitalTile.d: A metric with unit, trend and the threshold it’s judged against.
ex: <VitalTile label="p95 latency" value={412} unit="ms" data={series} threshold={{ value: 400, severity: 'caution' }} />
a11y: Severity label is text inside the tile.
VitalTile.do: Show the limit, not just the value.
VitalTile.dont: Don’t colour the tile without a label.

StationGrid.d: A worst-first grid of entity tiles for overview screens.
a11y: DOM order matches visual order so screen readers hear the worst first.

Timeline.d: One ordered record per entity: alerts, deploys, notes and people.
Timeline.dont: Don’t split one entity’s history across tabs.

LimitedNumberInput.d: Number entry with a soft limit that asks for a reason and a hard limit that blocks.
ex:
%
Higher than usual, add justification.
%
Maximum allowed is 60%.

<LimitedNumberInput label="Shift traffic to canary" unit="%"
  softMax={25} hardMax={60} requireJustification />
props: Warn and ask for a reason.
Shows a reason field past soft limits.
a11y: Warnings and errors are announced via aria-live.
LimitedNumberInput.do: Show the usual range in the hint.

PausePoint.d: A short checklist before a risky action. The action unlocks when every item is checked.
ex:
<PausePoint title="Before you publish" action="Publish" onConfirm={publish}
  items={['Diff reviewed by a second person','Rollback plan is linked']} />
PausePoint.do: Pre-fill items the system can verify.

ConfirmTarget.d: Type the exact name to delete, with the environment shown beside it.
ex: orders-euPROD
a11y: Paste is allowed; the match is exact and case-sensitive.
ConfirmTarget.do: Use on anything that can’t be undone.
ConfirmTarget.dont: Don’t use for reversible actions. Offer Undo.
